debasisr66/PennyExpenseManager.description: Penny is a simple, mobile-friendly personal expense manager. Amounts, budgets, imports and exports use Indian rupees (INR / ₹).

latest_release.name: Penny 3.3.5
latest_release.body:
**New: mobile-first pass. On phones, buttons and tap targets are at least 44 px, and small text is bigger.**

## Changes
- **Bigger tap targets (screens up to 700 px wide).** Buttons, Edit, Delete, tag chips and expandable headings are 44 px tall. Checkboxes and radio buttons are 24 px. There is 4 px between neighbouring targets, so Edit and Delete no longer touch.
- **Readable text.** The 9 and 10 px text is now 11 px.
- **Layout.** Stat tiles wrap: 2 + 1 at about 375-412 px, one per row at 360 px and below. The currency converter controls wrap in a grid. At 320 px an expense card is taller (about 290 px, was 256) because tags wrap one per line.
- **No change** to the wide (desktop) layout, data, schema 4, CSV and JSON formats, the security policy or the deploy list. Only `styles.css` and tests changed.

## Verification
- **Tests:** 800 automated tests pass in CI with 0 failures. One older test (TC-TH-M01) was changed to find the phone block by its marker.
- **Review:** built by a Sonnet 5.5 session, reviewed independently by Opus 5.5: no Blocker. Two High findings (amounts breaking mid-number, a missing arrow) were fixed and re-measured.
- **Browser audit (Chromium, both themes):** at 320, 360, 375, 390 and 412 px, the page and all 10 dialogs have 0 controls under 44 px and no sideways scroll. Also clean at 150% and 200% text (script-scaled).
- **Live site:** the Pages deploy succeeded after the merge.
- **Not covered:** no real phone, iOS Simulator or VoiceOver check. Text scaling was script-based, not the OS setting. **Landscape phones (812 x 375) keep the old small controls**; a follow-up is needed.

## Please check on your phone
Tell us if anything looks cramped or wrong: the stat tiles, the converter, tall expense cards at 320 px, and the 3.3.4 zoom fix (Add expense, Cancel, Discard).

## Assets
- `PennyExpenseManager-v3.3.5.zip`: the full source at this tag. Its SHA-256 checksum is in the `.sha256` file.

Live app: https://debasisr66.github.io/PennyExpenseManager/
